ports.original_data: Use your own exact arcade ROM set avspu (USA 940520), including its game key file, from a board you own. Another region or revision does not substitute for it. Keep originals separate and unchanged. The launcher accepts the set ZIP or its files folder and checks the files by checksum; when shared files are split, keep the matching parent ZIP beside it. Portcove registration does not authenticate the set or supply copyrighted game files.

ports.upstream_maturity_limit: This is upstream beta software. Upstream reports only scripted first-stage play and no human play observation for this newer beat-em-up.

ports.original_data: Use your own Cadillacs and Dinosaurs CPS-1/QSound arcade set dino (World 930201), from a board you own. The launcher accepts the set ZIP or its files folder and checks the files by checksum; when shared files are split, keep the matching parent ZIP beside it. Portcove registration does not authenticate the set or supply copyrighted game files.
